note: Identifies the public-data packs the Map ships: which source, which dates, which builder and schema. Kept consistent with the pack files by tests/test_packs_registry.py. The Map itself reads each pack's own header (the Canada snapshot, the US index.json). `verification` says how far a pack has been checked; the three levels and the fields each needs are defined in `verification_levels` and on /guide (I-PACK-*).

packs.title: Canada: ISED Fixed Service sites and links

source.dataset: SMS Authorization Data Extract, Fixed Service (TAFL_LTAF_Fixe)

records.heights: per-link endpoint antenna heights (ISED column 29 "Height above ground level [m]"), licensee-submitted record values

licence.name: Open Government Licence - Canada
licence.status: stated on the open.canada.ca catalogue record

verification.basis: Built directly from ISED's published SMS Authorization Data Extract (Fixed Service), source file updated 2026-09-01. Not compared with a second source and not confirmed by operators.

packs.title: United States: FCC ULS microwave sites and links

licence.name: U.S. Government Works
licence.status: public record published for public use (data.gov listing); licensee-reported record data, not field measurement (see data/us/index.json)

verification.basis: Built directly from the FCC ULS public access database (Microwave, l_micro.zip), file dated 2026-09-27. Not compared with a second source and not confirmed by operators.

source-published.means: Built directly from the official data the agency publishes. No extra check.

cross-checked.means: Compared against a named independent second source.
cross-checked.rule: basis says how the comparison was made; second_source names the independent source; sample_size is the number of records compared; match_result states what matched and what did not (for example '412 of 420 records matched on position and frequency; 8 differed, listed in the pack notes').

operator-confirmed.means: Written confirmation from the operator or a trusted contributor for this pack version.
operator-confirmed.rule: The written confirmation is kept privately; evidence_ref is an opaque reference to it (for example 'OC-2026-001'). Partner names are never shown publicly: basis and every other public field must not name the operator or contributor.
